promo.title: Promotions
promo.intro: One code per order. A code is never reused — deleted ones count too.

form.codeHint: 3–32 letters and digits · Shown upper-case. Customers can type it in any case.
form.active: Active — customers can use it in its window
form.needNumber: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.

promo.noneHint: Create a code customers can type at checkout.

users.title: Users
users.noneHint: Check the spelling, or clear the filters.

access.title: Access
access.roleBody: What this person can open: the shop, the staff screens, or admin.
access.lockBody: Stops sign-in for a while, or until you unlock it.
access.deactivateBody: Signs them out everywhere. Their email and orders stay; you can restore the account.
access.own: This is your own account — you can't change it here.

roleConfirm.title: Make {{name}} {{role}}?
roleConfirm.body: They'll be signed out; the new role applies at their next sign-in.

lockDialog.body: They're signed out and can't sign in until the lock ends or you unlock it.
lockDialog.untilHint: optional · up to 365 days · empty = until unlocked
lockDialog.past: Choose a date from today on.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivateDialog.body: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in. Their email stays reserved and their orders stay. You can restore the account.
